name: GYS1 (PSSM1)
summary: GYS1 (PSSM1), tying-up - a dominant disorder, so every copy shows and there is no carrier. Neither combination is lethal.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: PSSM1 (tying-up)
phenotypes.description: The muscle stores sugar it cannot burn. The horse ties up under work - it tires sooner than it should and does not move freely afterwards.

phenotypes.name: PSSM1 (two copies)
phenotypes.description: Two copies. The same disorder, worse: episodes come on under less work and take more out of the horse. It still lives an ordinary life.
